correctness.rationale: PASS: For n=2^alpha p^beta q^gamma the exact unitary-divisor sum (2^alpha+1)(p^beta+1)(q^gamma+1) and Das's necessary sigma*(n)>=2n yield monotone rational restrictions p=3 or 5. The p=5 branch forces n=70; p=3 yields only 6q^c, 60, and 90. The converse is independently demonstrated by explicit equal-sum partitions of all unitary divisors, and of all proper unitary divisors, in every branch. Independent exact brute subset-partition checks agreed on 1,344 cases for odd p<q in {3,5,7,11,13,17,19} with exponents 1..4. The finite checks are regression tests; the symbolic bounds prove all primes/exponents. Boundary alpha=1 and c>=1 are covered.
